data.title: Relay: what changed today (11-12)
data.body: Try them in this order. Ask me in chat to demo any card.

data.title: 1 · One-row cards
data.body: Status cards are one compact row. Hover → X dismisses (stays gone after reload). Click to expand. Canvas, room, sign-in, sessions all use it.

data.title: 2 · Live browser + trail
data.body: Agents drive real tabs in your session. Dotted route shows before each move, last 5 moves fade over ~6 s, click ripples. Purchase Allow: still broken.

data.title: 3 · Chat-driven canvas
data.body: This board. I edit it live from the chat with my cursor; your comments on cards come into the chat.

data.title: 4 · Design Mode
data.body: Page tab → toggle in address bar. Hover, click/Shift-click, drag a region; tweak styles or draw; Send → chat gets selector, screenshot, source file:line.

data.title: 5 · Live meetings
data.body: Teams call → 'Meeting in progress' card in Astra's chat (work) or mine. Click → transcript in side panel; quick asks post to chat. Relay replaced MeetingTranscriber.

data.title: 6 · Fullscreen video fix
data.body: Browser tabs hide while a chat video is fullscreen, come back after.

data.title: 7 · Phone
data.body: Reopen Relay: scrollbar reaches the bottom; meeting card opens full-screen view.

data.title: Next up
data.body: Canvas auto-layout (ELK) + step/explainer cards, then this board gets rebuilt with them.
